item.text: The switchover temperature is **35°F (about 1.7°C)**. At that outdoor temperature and below, the natural gas furnace takes over heating from the heat pump. See Section 1.2.1.5, “Backup System and Switchover Temperature,” on printed page 5 of the [ResStock dual fuel heat pump measure documentation](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96414.pdf#page=13).
